item.title: 30 Aug: AI bursts to the front of Massachusetts Democratic Senate primary
item.description: • AI bursts to the front of Massachusetts Democratic Senate primary • Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras • California's legislature passes a bill exempting open-source OSes like Linux from a twenty twenty-five age-verification law; Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android remain in scope • Data center development is driving demand for acoustic consultants, as developers and neighboring communities hire acousticians to assess noise emissions • Faro, which develops data models and AI tools to speed up clinical trials, raised a thirty-seven point three million dollar Series B co-led by Merck Global Health Innovation Fund and S thirty-two
